note: ADR-6: the Personal Agent wave is iOS-only. Each exception expires when its named Android synchronization milestone is reviewed; an Android mapping makes the entry stale.

pages.reason: The four-root retained NavigationStack shell and single Worker anchor have no Android counterpart in this wave.
The iOS HomeSpec Chat button and three-entry capsule are new iOS chrome; Android keeps its existing navigation during this wave.
The native Personal Agent conversation, memory candidates and minimal tool status are iOS-only in this wave.
The two-step owner and agent naming flow is introduced with the iOS Personal Agent first-run experience.
Connector, plugin and hardware discovery is introduced on iOS first under ADR-6.
The generic six-section connector detail contract is introduced on iOS before connector Android adapters exist.
The iOS discovery catalog reuses native plugin pages; Android plugin migration is outside this wave.
The seven-section Personal Agent profile is a new iOS root with no Android profile shell.
Agent naming and personal context are Personal Agent features excluded from the Android wave.
Personal Memory is distinct from the existing memory pressure probe and has no Android implementation.
pages.milestone: Android Personal Agent data layer review

pages.reason: Persistent Personal Agent follow-ups and their attention states are iOS-only in this wave.
Follow-up conditions, pause and stop actions are iOS-only in this wave.
This iOS profile grouping reuses existing native preferences and does not create an Android settings contract in this wave.
Agent presets move beside the iOS DSH new-session entry; Android session composition remains unchanged.
